title: fix(app-shell): the membership-tier and hook-object flags read in the designer's locale (objectui#10448)
body:
Fixes #10448

Clause-②: no — two designer display strings move onto the catalogue; no export, schema or accept set moves.

## What changes

Two designer unknown-value flags were English template literals. Both now go through `flagUnknownValue` (the objectui#9652 device in `inspectors/_shared.tsx`), so the `engine.form.flaggedValue` template decides the order of value and flag and the gap between them.

| site | before | new catalogue row (en / zh) | locale channel |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `FlowReferenceField.tsx`, `ReferenceCombobox` org-membership-level strict select, a stored tier outside the enum | `` `${current} (invalid)` `` | `engine.form.invalid` = `(invalid)` / `（无效）` | `useMetadataLocale()` (the control has no `locale` prop) |
| `HookDefaultInspector.tsx`, object picker `pickerOptions`, a selected object the live catalog does not list | `` `${n} (not published)` `` | `engine.form.notPublished` = `(not published)` / `（未发布）` | the `locale` prop the inspector already receives |

- The zh words are the catalogue's own: `engine.list.invalid` is `无效`, `engine.studio.unpublished` is `未发布`. Both zh flags open with a full-width bracket, as the comment above the zh flag rows requires.
- en is byte-identical: `{value} {flag}` with the en flag rebuilds the pre-fix string exactly, and both en cases pin it as a literal.
- `pickerOptions` re-derives on the `locale` primitive, not on the `tr` callback identity (AGENTS.md rule #10).
- `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: one EN hunk and one ZH hunk, each directly after that table's `engine.form.deprecated` row, inside the `engine.form.*` flag block. Both are hunk-disjoint from the open PRs objectui#10509 and objectui#10527, which also edit this file.
- Changeset: `.changeset/10448-designer-invalid-not-published-flags.md` (`'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`).

## Pins: red on base, green on head

New files, one beside each site: `inspectors/FlowReferenceField.flag.i18n-10448.test.tsx` and `inspectors/HookDefaultInspector.flag.i18n-10448.test.tsx`. Each has three cases:
- a non-vacuity guard: the zh row is not the key, not the en row, and opens with a full-width bracket;
- a zh case: the RENDERED text is the value followed directly by the catalogue's zh flag. FlowReferenceField mounts an `I18nProvider` in zh. HookDefaultInspector passes `locale` and waits for the object catalog to answer first;
- an en control: the pre-fix literal, byte for byte.

**Red on base `111fa4c94`** (only the two new test files added): `Tests  4 failed | 2 passed (6)`. The 2 passes are the en controls. The FlowReferenceField zh case failed with `Received: "sales_manager (invalid)"`. The Hook zh case found no checkbox with the zh-flagged name; the checkbox on screen was named `ghost_object (not published)`. Both guards were red (the key was echoed).

**Green on head `e337f8c1e`**: those two files, the objectui#9652 flag suite and the seven existing FlowReferenceField / HookDefaultInspector suites gave `Test Files  10 passed (10)` and `Tests  75 passed (75)`.

**Ablation on the committed head.** The catalogue rows stayed; only the site went back to its English literal. It ran through `ablation-replace.mjs`, which reported: anchor 1 to 0, blob changed, restored blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- FlowReferenceField: `Expected: "sales_manager（无效）"`, `Received: "sales_manager (invalid)"`, `Tests  1 failed | 2 passed (3)`.
- HookDefaultInspector: no checkbox named `ghost_object（未发布）`; the rendered name was `ghost_object (not published)`. `Tests  1 failed | 2 passed (3)`.

## Local verification (head `e337f8c1e`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), after building the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists both new test files.
- Tests, narrowed and declared. The full `packages/app-shell/` run did not finish inside the foreground cap (killed at 570 s, exit 124), so it is NOT MEASURED locally; CI runs it. The narrowed set had 117 files: the whole `metadata-admin/inspectors/` directory; every test file outside it that names FlowReferenceField, HookDefaultInspector, FlowObjectListField, FlowNodeConfigField, ReferenceCombobox or default-inspector-registry; every test naming `metadata-admin/i18n`; the metadata-admin i18n suites; and the four `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-*` suites. Result: `Test Files  117 passed (117)`, `Tests  1614 passed | 1 skipped (1615)`.
- Gates, each exit 0: `check-changeset-presence` (5 source files of 1 released package, 1 changeset); `check:new-line-citations` (`VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`); `check:control-bytes` OK; `check:i18n-keys`; `check:i18n-drift` (0 en values changed, 2 keys added); `check:i18n-designer-parity` (every en row has a zh row with the same placeholders); `check:i18n-dead-keys`; `check:vi-mock-specifiers` / `-inherit` / `-override-shape` OK; `check:test-path-roots` OK; `check:changeset-claims` (report-only: 3 pending changesets name `i18n.ts`, and all three still hold); `check:pending-changeset-literals`; `check-changeset-no-major`; `check:designer-field-key-parity`; `check-type-check-coverage`; `check:unreferenced-sources`.
- `check:eager-locale-catalogues`: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it reads a built console bundle), so NOT MEASURED.
- eslint on the five changed ts/tsx files (`--no-inline-config`, JSON output): 5 files, 0 errors, 10 warnings. All 10 are in `FlowReferenceField.tsx` and on lines this PR does not touch; the base blob of that file also gives 10. HookDefaultInspector.tsx gives 0 on base and on head. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, handed to the seat, not changed here: HookDefaultInspector's object picker flags a selected object `(not published)` while the object catalog is still loading, and again after that load fails, with no failure notice. A probe of the real component with the metadata client's `list` pending, and then rejected, rendered a checkbox named `account (not published)` both times. This is the same class as objectui#8862 / objectui#9651 (the in-flight and failed roster for `ViewColumnInspector`). This PR's Hook pin waits for the catalog to answer, so it does not pin that behaviour in either direction.
- Out of scope: both inspectors still render other hard-coded English under zh, for example `All objects (*)`, `Pick at least one object (or All objects).`, `Select at least one event.` and the `manager` cell's `Resolved automatically`. A zh-CN probe confirmed all four.
